pairing.codeHint: Type this code on the site
pairing.rateLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again later.
pairing.saveFailed: Could not save the pairing. Try again.

room.revealHint: Open the Party panel (P) and click the eye to show the game name.

consent.heading: Screen capture
consent.captured: The agent captures only the Diablo II: Resurrected game window, and only while the game runs and you have allowed it. It never captures the desktop or another window.
consent.sent: The agent sends the characters on the character selection screen (name, class, level, mode, ladder, era and unlocked difficulties) and the screen the game shows.
consent.neverLeaves: The captured images never leave this PC. They are kept in memory only.
consent.allowed: Capture is allowed on this PC.
consent.withdrawn: Capture is off. The agent reads nothing.
consent.notSaved: Could not save your choice. Try again.

readyCheck.hotkey: A ready check is open: press {{key}} to accept it.
readyCheck.unavailable: The accept hotkey ({{key}}) could not be registered: another program may be using it. Choose another combination in the Hotkeys section of this window. (reason: {{reason}})

hotkeyPress.none: Last hotkey press: none since the agent started
hotkeyPress.accept: Last hotkey press: the accept key
hotkeyPress.fill: Last hotkey press: the fill key
hotkeyPress.unmatched: Last hotkey press: a key that matches neither hotkey

post.rate-limited: Last send: too many requests, will retry
post.network: Last send: could not reach the server
post.check-ended: Last send: the ready check ended

party.none: Party panel: not looked at yet
party.notRead: Party panel: open, name field not read
party.empty: Party panel: open, name field empty
party.masked: Party panel: open, name field masked
party.text: Party panel: open, name field shows another name

source.label: Party field: read under the label ({{variants}} variants read)
source.labelLine: Party field: read on the label line ({{variants}} variants read)
source.layoutBox: Party field: read in the layout box, label not found ({{variants}} variants read)

closest.same: Party field, closest reading: same after normalising

capture.nothing: The capture shows nothing: no capture method gave a usable frame

fill.hint: To fill the game name, press {{key}} with the Game Creator open and its name field empty. The agent never presses Enter: confirm it yourself.
fill.typed: Game name typed. Press Enter in the game to confirm; the agent never does.
fill.stopped-focus: Typing stopped: the game lost focus.
fill.stopped-room: Typing stopped: the room changed or ended.
fill.stopped-press: Typing stopped: you pressed the key again.
fill.refused-room: Nothing typed: the agent holds no room.
fill.refused-name: Nothing typed: the room's name is not one the agent types.
fill.refused-focus: Nothing typed: the game does not have focus.
fill.refused-screen: Nothing typed: a game is running. Fill the name from the lobby.
fill.refused-keys: Nothing typed: let go of the hotkey's keys and press it again.
fill.unavailable: The fill hotkey ({{key}}) could not be registered: another program may be using it. Choose another combination in the Hotkeys section of this window. (reason: {{reason}})

refused.no-modifier: Use Ctrl or Alt with the key.
refused.needs-ctrl-or-alt: Use Ctrl or Alt with the key; Shift alone is not enough.
refused.reserved: That combination is already used by Windows or every program (such as Ctrl+C, Alt+F4 or the Windows key). Pick another.
refused.confirming-key: Enter, Tab, Space, Escape and Backspace cannot be hotkeys.
refused.unsupported-key: Use a letter, a digit or F1 to F12 (for example Ctrl+Shift+F).
refused.not-saved: Could not save the hotkey. Try again.
